harness.role: Pull Belstone's public league feed nightly and file what drifted, so the demo club never goes stale.
context_sources: scripts/belstone-2026-27.json (floor snapshot when the FWP feed is unavailable)
constraints: belstone only - this agent never touches Kilburn or any other club
writes only what the league publishes: results, fixtures, standings, progress, and season-numbers on players
never invents injuries, availability or training data for these real people
one notice per run, only when something actually drifted
harness.done_when: a notifications row of kind 'notice' exists for today naming what drifted, or the run reports nothing-to-do because the feed had nothing new

comms.actuation: notifications table, kind=notice, read in the app by manager and coach
comms.note: no outbound email - same boundary as availability-chaser, Belstone has no contact channel and none should be invented

capabilities.db_read: clubs, results, fixtures, league_standings, league_progress, players
capabilities.db_write: results, fixtures, league_standings, league_progress, players.external_stats, notifications insert

permissions.note: the route refuses without CRON_SECRET, and RLS scopes every write to the club row it read. neither depends on the model

tenancy.note: hardcoded to slug=belstone; this agent does not iterate clubs the way availability-chaser does

audit.note: the notice body is the diff itself: fixtures added, results refreshed, players updated, names the feed could not match
